# Three Blocks Pro

> Worker-based physics engine for Three.js WebGPU with SharedArrayBuffer communication

Three Blocks Pro provides a high-performance physics simulation running in a dedicated Web Worker at 60 FPS. It features capsule-based character controllers, third-person camera systems, trigger zones, and kinematic platforms.

- Package: `@three-blocks/pro`
- Requires: Three.js r182+ with WebGPU, SharedArrayBuffer support

## Documentation
- [Full API Reference](https://threejs-blocks.com/pro/llms-full.txt): Complete API documentation
- [LLM Guide](https://threejs-blocks.com/pro/LLM_GUIDE.md): Integration checklist for AI assistants
- [User Guide](https://threejs-blocks.com/pro/USER_GUIDE.md): 3rd person game implementation guide
- [Architecture](https://threejs-blocks.com/pro/ARCHITECTURE.md): Technical architecture documentation

## Core
Core physics initialization and control APIs.

- **Physics**: Main thread interface for initializing and controlling the physics engine.
- **PhysicsController**: High-level controller for player movement and camera control.

## Diagnostics
Performance metrics and analytics for physics runtime.

- **PhysicsInfo**: Real-time physics performance metrics and body analytics, available via `physics.

## State
Physics state management and SharedArrayBuffer schemas.

- **physicsState**: Central physics state container used in the worker.
- **DYNAMIC_BODY_SCHEMA**: Schema for dynamic body SharedArrayBuffer.
- **CAMERA_SCHEMA**: Schema for camera SharedArrayBuffer.

## Synchronization
Thread synchronization utilities using Atomics.

- **SyncFlag**: Indices into the sync buffer for different synchronization points.
- **acquireLock**: Acquire a lock by setting flag to LOCKED.
- **releaseLock**: Release a lock and notify waiting threads.
- **waitForUnlock**: Wait for a lock to be released using Atomics.

## Constants
Physics engine configuration constants.

- **BodyType**: Physics body type identifiers.
- **CameraMode**: Available camera modes.
- **FIXED_TIMESTEP**: Fixed physics timestep in seconds (1.
- **DEFAULT_GRAVITY**: Default gravity scalar (-9.

## Store
Lightweight state management (Zustand replacement).

- **createStore**: Create a vanilla store with get/set/subscribe API.
- **shallow**: Shallow compare two values for equality.
